display.purpose: Hero headlines on editorial surfaces and session-start moments. Deep Manuscript (#2c2218). Never on dashboard data.

headline.purpose: Section titles on editorial surfaces (/our-story, case detail). Deep Manuscript or Espresso.

title.purpose: Card headings in glass surfaces, dossier names. Espresso (#3B2F2F).

body.purpose: All running text, dashboard prose, coach insights. Espresso. Max 65–75ch for prose blocks.

label.purpose: Table headers, tag annotations. ONE eyebrow per screen maximum. Scholar Green for active; Sienna at 50% for passive.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Glass-card resting shadow. Nearly invisible separator between card and page ground.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive cards and portrait nodes on hover.

shadows.name: modal-deep
shadows.purpose: Dossier dialogs and full-screen overlays only.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible ring on interactive nodes. Scholar Green at 12% opacity.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Standard spring ease-out. Entrances, card reveals, dropdown open.

motion.name: spring-snappy
motion.purpose: Slightly faster spring. Tab transitions, scale-in for modals.

motion.name: ease-exit
motion.purpose: Exit transitions — elements leaving the screen.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: State changes: color, opacity, border. Not for transform animations.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: Element entrances (scale-in, rise). Never exceed 0.5s for UI transitions.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Primary mobile breakpoint. Constellation layout collapses; nav adapts.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard grid switches to 1-column from md:grid-cols-3.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The canonical action trigger. Sharp rectangle, Scholar Green fill, uppercase tracking. Hover lifts and darkens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 26px; background: #3D5A35; color: #fff8f0; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.25s ease, gap 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2f4829; gap: 12px; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3D5A35; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Scholar Green text on transparent background, same typography as primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 13px 26px; background: transparent; color: #3D5A35; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(61,90,53,0.3); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(61,90,53,0.07); border-color: rgba(61,90,53,0.6); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3D5A35; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The canonical content container. Frosted Ivory Press with backdrop blur and Scholar Green border tint.
components.html:
Session Score

Your average across the last 5 sessions has improved by 4 points.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(61, 90, 53, 0.10); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(59, 47, 47, 0.04); padding: 24px; } .ds-glass-card-title { font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 500; color: #3B2F2F; letter-spacing: -0.005em; margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-glass-card-body { font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #3B2F2F; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Base text field. Ivory Press ground, Scholar Green-tinted border that deepens on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(92, 64, 51, 0.55); } .ds-input { background: #fff8f0; color: #3B2F2F; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(61,90,53,0.15); border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(92, 64, 51, 0.45); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(61,90,53,0.45); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(61,90,53,0.6); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top-level navigation link. Stone-warm at rest; Scholar Green with underbar when active.
components.html: RepositoryDashboardPractice
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #57534e; text-decoration: none; padding: 4px 0; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #3D5A35; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #3D5A35; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-link--active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: #3D5A35; border-radius: 1px; }

components.name: Label / Eyebrow
components.description: Uppercase tracking label. Scholar Green for active/primary; muted Sienna for passive. Maximum one eyebrow per screen.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3D5A35; display: flex; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-eyebrow--muted { color: rgba(92, 64, 51, 0.5); }

components.name: Score Numeral
components.description: The most editorial moment in the product UI. Newsreader serif renders performance data. Never Work Sans for a score.
components.css: .ds-score { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-score-value { font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3D5A35; line-height: 1; } .ds-score-label { margin-top: 4px; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(92, 64, 51, 0.5); }

narrative.overview:
Case CompendiumX carries the visual authority of a well-produced print casebook — the serif editorial weight, the warm-cream ground, the measured hierarchy — and then the interface opens its eyes. AI transcription runs in the background; feedback surfaces at session end; score trends accumulate over weeks. The design must be serious enough that a candidate trusts it mid-case, and transparent enough that the AI layer feels inevitable rather than intrusive.

The palette is not a stylistic choice — it is institutional inheritance. Ivory Press (#fff8f0) and Warm Ash (#f4ede3) are the page; Espresso (#3B2F2F) is the ink; Scholar Green (#3D5A35) is the margin note that earns your attention. Newsreader carries the editorial voice; Work Sans does the operational work.

This system explicitly rejects the brash SaaS dashboard aesthetic — no data-heavy corporate grids, no achievement-badge gamification, no sterile minimalism stripped of warmth.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial type hierarchy: Newsreader for voice, Work Sans for function — never mixed within the same role
Warm cream ground with forest green as the single committed accent (Restrained strategy)
Sharp rectangular CTAs (radius: 0) — confidence through refusal to decorate
Glass-surface cards: backdrop-filter blur on Ivory Press, not opaque panels
Motion is purposeful: spring entrances and state-change transitions only — no orchestrated page choreography
Deep Manuscript (#2c2218) for major display headings; Espresso (#3B2F2F) for body text — two distinct near-blacks, each with a specific role

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Scholar Green appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its presence means 'action' or 'selected.' A screen saturated with Scholar Green is a screen that has lost its editorial authority.

rules.name: The Two Ink Rule
rules.body: Deep Manuscript is for display type. Espresso is for body text. They are not interchangeable — swapping them on a screen breaks the hierarchy that orients the reader at a glance.

rules.name: The Gold Reserve Rule
rules.body: Antique Gold is never introduced in new surfaces. It belongs to the /our-story constellation and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Role Purity Rule
rules.body: Newsreader appears in display/headline/title roles and score numbers. Work Sans appears in body/label/data roles and all interactive controls. Mixing fonts within the same functional role is prohibited.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Product UI surfaces use fixed rem sizes, not clamp(). Fluid display type is reserved for editorial surfaces where the heading is the visual anchor.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only in response to state (hover lift, dropdown opening, modal entrance) or layer context.

rules.name: The Glass-Not-Card Rule
rules.body: When a surface needs to float above the page ground, prefer backdrop-filter blur over opaque background. Glass reads as air; opaque panels read as walls.

dos: Do use sharp rectangular buttons (border-radius: 0) for all primary CTAs
Do keep Scholar Green to primary actions, active nav, and focus states only
Do use Newsreader for display, headline, title, and score-numeral roles exclusively
Do use rgba(61, 90, 53, 0.10) for card borders — Scholar Green tint at 10%
Do include @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) on every keyframe animation
Do use Material Symbols Outlined at wght 300, FILL 0 for all icons
Do document intentional palette variations per surface — warm brown shades on /case are deliberate
donts: Don't use brash SaaS dashboard aesthetics — heavy data grids, neon accents, achievement badges, confetti
Don't use generic mock-interview or quiz-tool UI patterns — progress bars as primary feedback, badge counts, streak indicators
Don't use overly gamified touches — streaks, confetti on completion, star ratings in gaming style
Don't let Scholar Green appear as a background on large surfaces or as a decorative fill
Don't use Antique Gold (#D8B978) outside the /our-story constellation
Don't round primary buttons — border-radius: 0 is intentional
Don't nest glass cards — a .glass-card inside a .glass-card eliminates visual hierarchy
Don't use modal dialogs as a first response to user actions — exhaust inline and progressive alternatives
Don't use Newsreader in buttons, labels, table cells, or form controls
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or callouts
Don't add gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient)
Don't produce minimalist-to-the-point-of-sterile design — warmth is required
